meta.title: Prototype-to-PRD | AI Collaboration Workspace
meta.description: Detect specification gaps in a prototype, resolve product semantics through a Human Gate, and generate an implementation-ready PRD.

hero.title: Prototype-to-PRD
hero.summary: Transform observable prototype facts into implementation-ready specifications while returning product semantics unsupported by evidence to a Human Gate.

sections.label: Core Problem
sections.title: A prototype shows interface behavior, not complete product rules
sections.summary: Entry points, fields, and action order are observable. Permissions, states, exceptions, data ownership, and success boundaries are usually missing.

items.label: Prototype facts
items.title: Safe to transform
items.body: Page structure, controls, navigation, and observable user actions.

items.label: Product semantics
items.title: Not safe for AI to infer
items.body: Who may act, whether failure blocks progress, the next state, and when an output becomes official.

sections.note: The prototype limitation is not missing volume; it is evidence that cannot uniquely support a product decision.

sections.label: Collaboration Method
sections.title: AI detects gaps, humans decide semantics, AI transforms the specification
sections.summary: Observable facts are separated from missing rules before ambiguities that change product behavior reach the Human Gate.

items.label: AI
items.title: Detect specification gaps
items.body: Check missing conditions, broken exception loops, state conflicts, and unverifiable assumptions.

items.label: Human Gate
items.title: Confirm product semantics
items.body: Resolve only root questions that evidence cannot decide and that change the business outcome.

sections.note: AI must not present a plausible assumption as a confirmed rule.

sections.label: Representative Evidence
sections.title: One “complete” action exposed an ambiguous business end state
sections.summary: The workbench provided a completion control, but the prototype could not prove whether completion entered review or immediately created an official result.

items.label: Gap Detection
items.title: AI surfaced the root question
items.body: Should completion enter review or archive immediately? Both plausible end states cannot be true.

items.label: PRD Transformation
items.title: The decision became an acceptance-ready rule
items.body: Visibility conditions, state change, failure blocking, and recovery were written into a local specification rather than a full PRD report.

evidence.alt: XML dual-source comparison prototype with sources, working copy, and completion control
evidence.label: Prototype Evidence
evidence.title: Interface facts and missing rules coexist
evidence.description: The screenshot proves that the action exists; the adjacent judgment shows that it does not define completion criteria, exception blocking, or the next state.

sections.note: One representative artifact shows how a judgment moves from prototype evidence into a specification.

sections.label: Result
sections.title: Frozen at v1.0 after historical regression
sections.summary: Project A / B validated that gap detection, the Human Gate boundary, and PRD transformation could transfer across projects.

items.label: Validated
items.title: Reliably transform evidence-supported content
items.body: Regression focused on specification misses, unauthorized AI decisions, and unnecessary Human Gates rather than retelling historical projects.

sections.note: The method is frozen; product semantics are not delegated to AI.
